finding: A plain-language preregistered prediction with a measured result scored Π=0 because invariant/certainty markers were absent.
evidence: TP-C002 and targeted 'supported plain language' case
root_cause: P is operationalized from INVARIANT_PATTERNS such as 'proven', 'by definition', 'theorem', and 'must be', not from demonstrated explanatory reach.

finding: Unsupported certainty language scored Π=0.831 while the measured prediction case scored Π=0.
evidence: 'By definition this proven theorem must be true because therefore the framework explains the pattern.'
root_cause: The numerator rewards co-occurrence of causal/theory tokens and foundational-certainty tokens without verifying evidence provenance.

finding: Π stayed invariant under exact repetition, but layer scores did not: FOUNDATION 1→31 and THEORY 18→89 after repeating the same sentence ten times.
root_cause: wordScale and fixed word-count bonuses remain in layer scores even though Π uses densities.

finding: Adding an honest caveat reduced Π from a high unsupported-certainty pattern to 0.030.
root_cause: EDGE markers combine genuine contradiction with honest uncertainty, caveats, limitations, and open questions, all of which increase S.

finding: The legacy reorganisation flag can be activated by repetition. The same two contradiction hits remained fixed while repeated certainty/theory text diluted their density; reorganisation changed from false to true around 7,509 words.
evidence: 100 repeats Π=.316 false; 500 repeats Π=.616 true; contradictionCount remained 2.
root_cause: Trigger combines density-based Π with an absolute contradiction-count gate, so length changes their relationship.

finding: Two live reorganisation definitions conflict. The legacy text lens requires Π>0.6 plus more than one incoherence hit, while the onion proposal states Π alone must trigger because a friction gate cancels the formula.
root_cause: Legacy compatibility path and newer onion governance evolved separately.

finding: Reorganisation fires at Π=τ even though comments and human-facing text state Π>τ.
root_cause: Code uses `if (pi < TAU) return none`, making equality pass.

finding: Applying a move transfers content only. Scores, falsifiability, and other layer metadata stay attached to their old positions.
root_cause: applyReorganisation and revertReorganisation copy only the content field.

finding: The judge defines high TENSION and CONTESTED scores as good acknowledgement, but computePi subtracts those high scores from coherence as if they measured the amount of unresolved tension.
evidence: onion tension 0 produced Π=427; tension 80 produced Π=164 while the judge rubric rewards naming tension well.
root_cause: Quality-of-handling and quantity-of-strain share the same field with opposite semantic polarity.

finding: A syntactically valid partial JSON verdict is accepted; missing layers default to zero and falsifiable defaults true. Applying it overwrites eight existing framework scores with zero.
evidence: isolated parser harness using only layer 0
root_cause: Parser validates JSON syntax but not schema completeness.

finding: The receipt records uncommitted working-tree changes, so the Git commit alone cannot reproduce the uploaded source.
root_cause: Snapshot was taken from a dirty working tree.
mitigation: Byte-level SHA-256 hashes are now preserved.

finding: Source reveals an additional pyramid-level Π computed from average score, maximum score, and score spread. It is a fourth operationalization beyond canon, text Π, and block-onion Π.
root_cause: Different constructs share Π and may share band language.

finding: The result type names AXIOM and CHAOS and exposes a paradoxical flag, but the function constructs only FOUNDATION, THEORY, and EDGE. The paradoxical test therefore remains false in this implementation.
root_cause: Five-layer type/schema drifted from three-layer returned data.

finding: The official six-check gate passes, but the frozen 24-case corpus produced Π=0 for all 24 natural-language cases.
root_cause: Existing gate tests use the engine's own marker vocabulary and do not test general-language evidence, marker gaming, quotation, negation, or governance.
